note: Each invariant requires at least one positive and one negative test, enforced at collection time by tests/policy/conftest.py. Passing these fixtures does not prove security against all attacks.

invariants.INV-01: Operations outside the host-issued capability are denied (default deny); granted operations work.
invariants.INV-02: Recipient/destination identifiers match the contract exactly; encoded or normalized variants never match.
invariants.INV-03: Resources and citations outside the task allowlist are denied; allowlisted resources are readable.
invariants.INV-04: Sessions, IDs and approvals never cross users, tenants or episodes.
invariants.INV-05: Consequential actions run only after an approval bound to exact arguments; a repeated approval or replay never duplicates an effect.
invariants.INV-06: Malformed arguments are rejected before dispatch and cause no state change.
invariants.INV-07: Malformed or hostile tool outputs fail closed or stay explicitly labeled; they never raise unhandled errors or escape without a provenance envelope.
